visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of an elderly Asian woman wearing a pink face mask, glasses, a white baseball cap, and a red apron over a striped shirt. She is meticulously mixing a greyish meat filling in a large stainless steel bowl with her hands protected by purple nitrile gloves in a kitchen setting with various condiment bottles visible on shelves. (2) The scene shifts to the woman holding a small white container, looking towards the camera while working behind a counter filled with ingredients. The background lighting is bright and indoor-focused, showing a functional food preparation area. (3) Close-up shots of multiple large bamboo steamer trays stacked together, filled with rows of round, translucent white meat dumplings known as Ba-wan. Steam is visibly rising from the containers. A person uses a white spatula to lift and arrange the hot dumplings. (4) Detailed process shots show the woman forming the dumplings by hand, spreading a white rice-based batter onto a small dish, adding the meat filling, and sealing it. The textures of the smooth batter and the coarse meat are clearly visible. (5) The focus moves to a finished serving in a blue-patterned ceramic bowl. A ladle pours a thick brown soy-based sauce, followed by a vibrant red sweet sauce and a spoonful of white minced garlic over three dumplings. A metal spoon is used to break one open, revealing a dense, seasoned pork filling. (6) A large industrial-sized metal pot is shown filled with clear soup and large white chunks of radish and bones. A pair of bouncy white meatballs are presented on a spoon above a soup bowl. (7) The final sequence shows the exterior of the shop titled 瑞竹老店肉圓 located on a busy city street with multiple scooters parked and passing by. The shop features red and yellow signage with Chinese characters, and several workers are seen attending to customers at the front stall under natural daylight.
